findings.finding_text: scanLiveShapePrereq accepts FAILED hindsight-live evidence (checks mode, never ok) — one failed first run vacuously satisfies the AC1 ordering gate downstream
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: Require parsed.ok === true in the prereq scan

findings.finding_text: Lock staleness asymmetry: legs hold provision.lock with a 900s steal budget but provisionBanks/CLI steal at 300s — a >300s window gets stolen mid-mint and compensation deletes the interleaver's banks (3-reviewer convergent)
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: Heartbeat: leg window refreshes the lock file mtime on an interval (<300s) so concurrent 300s-budget acquirers never see it stale; cleared in finally

findings.finding_text: hindsight-live mock rehearsal is not hermetic — fetchImpl defaults to globalThis.fetch unconditionally, so mock+env issues real writes and strands a lazy-created probe bank the mock client never deletes
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: Gate the fetch default on mode (live only); mock-without-injection records skipped-hermetic steps like the sibling drivers

findings.finding_text: CLI pre-provision snapshot fails OPEN to the fresh lane — one transient listBanks failure on a rerun mints qds-factory-2 junk (3-reviewer convergent)
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: Snapshot call failure -> fail-closed refusal envelope (exit 1); empty ROSTER (successful call) stays fresh-lane

findings.finding_text: CLI rerun lanes mutate the roster with no provision-family lock — a missing-roster-member create inside a leg's window gets deleted as that leg's residue (2-reviewer convergent)
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Rerun branch acquires provision.lock (holdProvisionerLock opt through rerunAwareProvision, or inline acquireFileLock)

findings.finding_text: F-007's probe-bank create is dead code on the live path (main never passes deps.client) — AC4's confound removal never executes on the box (2-reviewer convergent)
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Live main constructs the client (baseUrl-threaded) and passes it as deps.client so the create runs; create failure recorded as its own step + class

findings.finding_text: CLI rerun lanes print {ok,mode,createdInAttempt,raw} — no banks/requestId, violating the file's committed stdout contract; thrown branch lacks error.code
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Envelope normalized to the documented {ok,banks,requestId} shape (+error envelope on throw)

findings.finding_text: hindsight-live health + raw probe have no timeout budget — a half-open connection hangs the leg forever, breaking the resolves-for-every-outcome contract
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: AbortController budget (~10s, sibling parity) on both raw paths; timeout -> recorded failed step + leg failure

findings.finding_text: auth-retired-check narrates refused-unclassified probes (429/proxy-rewritten) as ANSWERED in the containment statement — the always-present verdict field asserts a measurement that did not happen
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Third outcome branch: refused-unclassified -> containment 'inconclusive — neither retired nor answered', dangerRetired false

findings.finding_text: macOS case-insensitive spelling escapes the mock-in-closure-dir refusal when the final path segment does not exist (lexical fallback + APFS case-folding on mkdir)
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Case-insensitive comparison on the lexical fallback path (darwin/win32), preserving exact-match on case-sensitive platforms

findings.finding_text: rerunAwareProvision consolidation gaps: rerun branch reports createdInAttempt [] even when it recreates missing roster members; idempotency-rerun still re-implements the fork inline (2-reviewer drift flag); shared-lane rerun fires realBridgeProbe whose verdict is discarded
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Helper opts gain provisionImpl + onStep; createdInAttempt = members absent from existingBankIds; probe computed only on the fresh lane; provisionOnce migrates to a thin wrapper

findings.finding_text: Prefix guard validates untruncated resolveBankId while provisioning mints safeRepoBase (truncate+trim) — guard value ≠ minted value
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Guard the safeRepoBase output (assertQdsRepoSlug returns base post-truncation)

findings.finding_text: negative-probes counts ANY non-2xx HTTP response as instance-unavailability proof — sound on the loopback-discard default, unsound on gateway-fronted QDS_PROBE_DOWN_URL overrides
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: downRefused only for transport-error/timeout classes; any HTTP answer (even 5xx) = something answered -> probe unproven, leg fails honestly

findings.finding_text: maskTail over-masks any word containing key/token (keyword, monkey) degrading shape evidence, and its value class truncates at &/space leaking credential tails
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Exact-word field names (drop \w* wrapping); quoted-context value masking to the closing quote; document the residual ceiling for exotic unquoted values

findings.finding_text: LegEvidence.origin and negative-probes downOrigin recorded unmasked — userinfo-bearing URLs leak credentials into evidence
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Strip userinfo at record time (URL parse, reconstruct without credentials)

findings.finding_text: forbiddenOrigin layer-1 suffix match runs before layer-2 URL-port — a dedicated origin with a path tail ending :8888 is falsely refused (fail-closed but wrong)
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: URL-port layer first when the string parses as a URL; suffix layer only for unparseable input

findings.finding_text: negative-probes client.listBanks?.() optional call — injected collaborators without the method yield [] snapshots and a vacuously-green zero-banks proof
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Require the method (absent -> fatal, not vacuous [])

findings.finding_text: Post-snapshot failure abandons compensation with residue:[] while created banks remain stranded — scrapers read clean
